results.answer: Roosevelt Island is the largest island in Manhattan, originally built as a military reserve during World War II to house troops stationed on Staten Island. The name was chosen by President Franklin D. Roosevelt after his wife Eleanor Roosevelt, who had been born there. Today, it serves as a major tourist destination and home to the famous Roosevelt Island Zoo.
